items.prompt: The same vocabulary source is built in C++23 mode, but __cpp_lib_expected is not defined by the installed library. Which Result and access path does the displayed program select?

options.text: std::expected, because the language mode takes precedence over feature macros.
options.why: The program selects the alias with a preprocessing condition on library support, not by language mode alone.

options.text: std::optional<int>, with nullopt for every ParseError.
options.why: No optional Result fallback exists here; optional is used by first_positive, a different API.

options.text: Compilation must fail before the variant branch can be parsed.
options.why: The guarded include and feature test permit a library without expected to use the variant branch.
The condition requires __cpp_lib_expected>=202202L; without it the explicitly written C++20 fallback is selected.
